text:
Maria: Quick reminder — we’re aiming to freeze main for v1.14.0 tomorrow 17:00 PT. Please: 1) bump the package version where applicable, 2) add a changelog bullet under Unreleased, and 3) file a release branch `release/v1.14.0` if you need backports. I’ll post an ETA in #announcements at ~17:15 PT. Post PR links here if they must be included. :megaphone:

Sam: CI is green on main now but integration-suite is flaky on the latest run — docker networking timeout in test 42. Investigating. If it doesn’t clear by 16:30 PT we should consider a slip.

Dev-bot: CI update — build/ci-main: passed; integration-suite: failing (3/5 flaky tests). See https://ci.example.com/build/9876

Keisha: tagging PR #4123 for changelog entry. I’ll open the release branch once CI looks stable. Also note: infra/worker needs a version bump, I can take that post-lunch.

Jonah: quick question — what’s the changelog format we’re expecting? One-liner + PR link?

Maria: Yep — one short sentence, scope in parens, and link the PR. Example: `fix(worker): avoid double dispatch when cache miss (#4123)`

Paul: Heads up — I have a late config change that touches DB migrations. If we can’t get full e2e by cutoff, I’d prefer to backport safe fixes only and hold migrations behind a feature flag.

Maria: Agreed. If e2e isn’t green we’ll cut the release branch and cherry-pick only safe fixes. Migration PRs should be deferred unless explicitly approved for manual rollout. I’ll update #announcements with either “on schedule” or a slip notice around 17:15 PT. Keep posting status here.

Sam: 16:20 PT — repro found: flaky test comes from a race in the harness. Putting a fix up now, PR -> #4129.

Maria: Thanks. @Keisha once Sam’s PR merges can you run `./scripts/bump-version.sh 1.14.0 && git push origin HEAD:release/v1.14.0` and create the branch?

Keisha: Yup, will do. ETA 16:45 PT.

CI-CD-bot: queued job — create-release-branch for release/v1.14.0 (waiting on permission).

Maria: 17:10 PT — quick update for announcements: CI stabilized, integration-suite all green after #4129. Cutting `release/v1.14.0` in 5 minutes and will post announcement now.

Maria: Posting to #announcements: `v1.14.0 scheduled for release tonight 00:30 UTC (rolling rollout). If anything slips we will update this channel.`

Jonah: Noted — bump PR merged.

Paul: Migration deferred to next minor; won’t ship tonight.

Keisha: Release branch created and version bumped. Changelog updated. Cherry-picked PRs: #4118, #4123, #4129.

Maria: ✅ Thanks everyone. I’ll create the release PR, tag ops to monitor the rollout, and post an update here if anything changes. If we need to slip to Monday I’ll send a slip notice to #announcements.

Sam: Adding a short note to the release PR about the flaky-test root cause and the fix we applied.

Keisha: All checks passing on the release branch now.

Maria: Great — marking this thread resolved for now. If anyone finds further issues please reply here and I’ll propagate to #announcements. :white_check_mark:
